settings.hero_desc: A finely modelled horse figure paired with miniature product packs on a branded base, presented under a clear case. A characterful corporate gift and counter display for equestrian, feed and lifestyle brands.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your figure, product packs, branding and base plaque
settings.s1_body: This display pairs a lifelike horse figure with miniature versions of your products, all on a branded base under a clear case. It tells your brand story at a glance - ideal as a corporate gift, a counter or reception display, or a trade-show piece for equestrian, feed and lifestyle companies. We model the figure and recreate your product range in miniature.
settings.case_heading: A Display That Tells the Brand Story
settings.case_body: Built as a branded display for a feed brand, this horse-and-products piece brought the brand to life on counters and at events - a memorable corporate gift that paired a lifelike figure with the company's own product range in miniature.
settings.case_quote: It captures our brand perfectly - the horse and our mini products together. Customers love it.
settings.prov_p: Pairing a characterful figure with your actual products turns a gift into a story. It is a display people keep - and one that quietly keeps selling your brand.
